tasks.instruction: User reauthorized Claude. Read GLOBAL_S3_CONTRACT.md and app/spherical-cover-model.js. Build full-S3 browser fixture on createSphericalFlight (space, balls, state camera/position/reference/travel/returnDistance, reset, advance(dt,wish,look), stepLoop(distance)). Allowed files listed only; no model/kernel/fixture changes. Implement WebGL2 static metric-ball first-hit renderer over one full 2*pi*R orbit, max16 balls, R8 fixture. CPU castSphericalBalls authority; explicit uncertain tangencies/ties, float guards. Surface normals, landmark colors; hits beyond piR retain physical distance. Debug readback status/owner/distance for parity. UI pointer lock/WASD/SpaceShift, reuse createMouseLook reset/spike lifecycle; Escape/focus clear. Run full loop button resets once, animates stepLoop to total2*piR over~13sec, NEVER teleport/reset endpoint at finish. Display circuit fraction/travel/shortest distance home; label no gravity/collision. Link new tools/spherical-cover.html from connected-preview. ?check compare CPU/GPU80x60 at start,quarter,exact antipode,threequarter,return,noncentral turned pose; confident status/owner agree, distance<=.001, >=95% CPUhit retention eachpose; report extra refusals and saved images. Verify frame/position closure. Add --spherical-cover to page-check and queue flag allowlist and relevant queue tests. Do not weaken tests. Browser unavailable in isolated clone: run syntax/Node checks only, disclose GPU unrun; lead will integrate then queue realGPU. No other agents/commits/pushes. Concise report READY FOR REVIEW.

MUSE-57. Read MUSE.md and GLOBAL_S3_CONTRACT. Only write global-s3-ray-truth.test.js and docs/qa/muse57-global-rays.md. Independently test EXISTING castSphericalBalls via chord-membership sampling+bisection at rotated poses/directions, multiple small balls, R=.5/8/10000. Include beyond-piR hits, finite-range misses, input permutation, later tangency before/behind nearer hit, exposed tangent refusal, coincident owners, zero budget. <=100 cases, ~5sec runtime, reference must resolve chosen object sizes. Report sampled-not-proven boundary. Do not repair kernel; give minimal counterexample if found. Demonstrate isolated wrong-root or piR-cap mutation failing, restore engine. Focused Node tests only, host-probe once, no browser/fullsuite/agents/commits/pushes. <500word report with measured errors/host/commands/limitations. READY FOR REVIEW. Manifest is full task if clone queue predates it.
